parse_bool_flag: parse a command line boolean flag string like true false on off or 1 0
validate_file: check if a given file path exists and has a non-zero file size
count_lines: count the number of lines in a file using the wc command
shuffle_parallel_files: shuffle multiple parallel files in the same random order and write shuffled outputs
split_arguments: split a comma-separated argument string respecting parentheses nesting and quoted strings
